name: openreloading
initializeCommand:
printf 'WORKSPACE=%s
GIT_COMMON=%s
PROJECT=openreloading-%s
' "$PWD" "$(cd "$(git rev-parse --git-common-dir)" && pwd)" "$(basename "$PWD" | tr A-Z a-z | tr -c 'a-z0-9
' -)" > .devcontainer/.env
postCreateCommand: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile && pnpm --filter @open-reloading/e2e exec playwright install --only-shell chromium
